The definitions have been purposely kept brief and pointed, yet it is hoped that no denotation which occurs with any degree of frequency has been neglected. For further information as to various connotations and nuances of meaning the following standard lexicons may be consulted.
Abbott-Smith, G., A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament (3rd ed., Edinburgh, 1937).
Reasonably complete and not unwieldy, but does not make full use of new material.
